verdict.rationale: The privacy-posture axis applies to a SaaS error-monitoring service that holds customer data, but nothing in the evidence addresses AI model training: there is no opt-out control, no contractual no-training commitment, and no AI data-use policy. Retroactive sensitive-data redaction and the self-hosted On-premise option are adjacent data-control features, not a documented mechanism to stop data from being used for training, so they earn no credit.
